hints.content:
The notation $f(2)$ refers to the output of the function when the input is $x=2$. If the point $(2,b)$ is on the graph, then $f(2)=b$.

We should look for the point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $2$.

The point on the graph whose $x$-coordinate is $2$ is the point $(2,-5)$.

**Therefore, $f(2)=-5$.**
